packages/ai/src/api/openai-codex-respons.note: Native Codex stream/streamSimple use shared Responses request preparation and conversion, SSE retry/timeouts/service-tier pricing, and real WebSocket streaming. The CLI-owned session pool supports exclusive reusable connections, independent request cancellation, concurrent one-shot requests, immutable cached-context deltas, invalidation and checkout-time expiry. Connection-limit errors retry once before output starts; missing previous responses retry once with a fresh full request, including after partial output. One run emits start once across retries/fallback. Transport failures remember SSE for later requests in that session, without disabling other sessions. Differential checks cover 27 SSE cases, 22 WebSocket scenarios and 15 consecutive-turn scenarios on Bun/native1/native4; cache helpers and pool ownership also have dedicated checks. Remaining: active idle-expiry timers, stale-peer checks, debug/cleanup APIs, transport diagnostics, generated WebSocket request IDs without a session, https:// proxy URLs (TLS to the proxy; the attempt falls back to SSE) and optional zstd compression. WebSocket connections take the proxy as upstream's Bun WebSocketWithProxy does: resolveHttpProxyUrlForTarget for the http(s) form of the URL with the request's provider env, then a CONNECT tunnel; an unsupported proxy URL fails the attempt (SSE fallback); tests/openai_codex_websocket_check.py proxy modes compare tunnel requests, credentials, NO_PROXY and failures with pinned pi. Approved differences: structural JSON equality, immutable event snapshots, strict malformed-input rejection; parser/fetch error wording is native.

Extension events: agent/turn_start/message/tool_execution events reach extensions before listeners, message_end replacements are persisted and projected, tool_call and tool_result run in the agent's tool hooks, agent_settled precedes the public event; navigateTree runs session_before_tree (cancel, supplied summary, instruction and label overrides) under the branch-summary controller and emits session_tree; manual and automatic compaction run session_before_compact (cancel or supplied result), then session_compact or session_compact_failed; waitForIdle waits for session-level idleness (no run, compaction or branch summary). turn_end boundaries run from the agent's finishTurn (or the turn_end event for synthesized failures) and agent_before_settle before settlement, with drafts previewed, committed and announced after the context refresh; post-run handling continues for queued messages only after retry and compaction (no queue drain before retry). The agent's transformContext runs the extensions' context handlers; getUserMessagesForForking, pendingMessageCount and harness-style appendSessionEntry/refreshSessionContext are present. prompt() follows upstream's order: extension command, compaction refusal, input handlers (source interactive/rpc/extension; streamingBehavior only while streaming), expansion, queue while streaming, then pending flushes and the preflight (formatNoModelSelectedMessage / formatNoApiKeyFoundMessage with the package docs path; the OAuth wording is unreachable because its snapshot entry exists exactly when hasConfiguredAuth holds); preflightResult reports acceptance before anything runs. Queued steer/followUp input passes the input handlers; upstream's refusal of extension commands there is not ported (steer/followUp report no failure). setShutdownHandler binds ctx.shutdown(). bindCore's getContextUsage, compact (a detached manual compaction; the session takes the onComplete/onError callbacks, calls one and disposes both) and getSystemPrompt are bound for ctx. before_agent_start runs after the preflight: handler messages follow the user message and next-turn messages; changed options (_runSystemPromptOptions) render the run's prompt and select its tools from the registry, next turns re-render them with the agent's tools, and a forced systemPrompt is sent as the request's one leading system message after the context handlers (_installAgentForcedPromptProjection); images are normalized for the model the handlers left selected. The extension setModel action switches only with configured auth. The appendEntry action appends a custom entry (sessionManager.appendCustomEntry). Extension tools: pi.registerTool definitions join the registry (_refreshToolRegistry: allowed built-in tools, extension tools replacing built-ins of their name, construction activates every extension tool, later refreshes activate new ones, allowlists activate listed tools), their snippets and guidelines join the system prompt, and the getActiveTools/getAllTools/setActiveTools actions are bound; setActiveToolsByName sets the agent's tools at once. bindExtensions emits session_start. Missing: session_switch/fork/shutdown extension events here (the runtime emits them), user_bash, _isEmittingAgentSettled deferral, and replaced messages inside turn_end/agent_end payloads. The skill-block parser used by restored transcripts is in core/skills.bend. Native appendLabelChange exposes session-manager label mutation through shared session ownership, using the existing atomic metadata append/persistence path. The context actions answer ctx.sessionManager with the current session record. SDK-created sessions now expose their injected ResourceLoader, retained in the loadout and used for reload preparation. sdk-skills checks default discovery and injected empty/custom skill results on native one/four.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/extension.note: Inline factories (named, or bare as <inline:N>) load into a runtime (loadExtensionFromFactory/loadExtensionFactories) with registerCommand, registerProvider/unregisterProvider (deferred while loading), on/unsubscribe, sendMessage, sendUserMessage with its options and setModel (failing before the session binds them with upstream's not-initialized message). No file discovery or jiti loading (JS extensions are excluded; extensions are compiled Bend). registerTool (refreshing a bound session), getActiveTools, getAllTools and setActiveTools. exec runs a command without a shell (Child.spawnSync) in options.cwd or the runner cwd; options.signal and timeout are not ported. registerFlag (typed defaults, pending until the extension commits, discarded with a failed one), getFlag, registerShortcut and appendEntry (the session appends a custom entry). Missing: renderers, session name/label, active tools, model and thinking actions, events bus. registerStreamingProvider and registerProviderConfig now preserve explicit native/config registration forms through deferred loading and bound ModelRuntime dispatch. Config-form behavior and renderer integration still need dedicated coverage.

Native ExtensionRunner: bindCore/bindCommandContext/setUIContext, command resolution with invocation names, error listeners, snapshotEventHandlers, emit for events without results, emitMessageEnd (same-role replacement chain), emitToolCall (first block wins, failures propagate), emitToolResult (patched fields), and the session_before_tree/session_before_compact results of emit (last result, cancel stops dispatch, failures reported). emitBoundary (turn_end/agent_before_settle: drafts and continuation carried between handlers, a preview rebuilt after each, invalid drafts reported). emitContext (context handlers on the conversation with system messages restored, then context_with_system; unchanged is structural equality). emitInput (each handler sees the input as the previous ones left it; handled stops dispatch; failures reported; transform when a handler transformed, not by array identity). emitBeforeAgentStart (messages collected, a returned systemPrompt forces the prompt, returned options replace the event's for later handlers since native handlers cannot edit them in place; systemPrompt is rendered for each handler). emit for session_start/session_shutdown and the cancelling session_before_switch/session_before_fork dispatch (stops at the first cancel). getAllRegisteredTools. getFlags (first registration of a name wins), setFlagValue and getFlagValues. createContext offers getContextUsage (None unbound), compact (a no-op that disposes the option callbacks unbound) and getSystemPrompt ("" unbound) through the bound context actions. emitUserBash (the first handler with a result decides; a failing one is reported and fails the command; results are operations or a replacing result by construction, so upstream's result validation has no counterpart). Missing: provider request/header events, emitCacheWarmingDecision, emitResourcesDiscover, getShortcuts (shortcuts are stored, but keybinding conflicts are not resolved), renderers, tool registrations, invalidate/stale contexts. The runner owns the context reader its built-in tools are created with (upstream's ctxFactory).

Typed native events and results for agent_start/end/settled, turn_start, message_start/update/end, tool_execution_*, tool_call, tool_result, session_before_tree/session_tree (TreePreparation, summary and instruction overrides), session_before_compact/session_compact/session_compact_failed, turn_end/agent_before_settle boundaries (SessionBoundaryDraft, BoundaryContextPreview, BoundaryResult, AgentActivityOutcome), commands, InlineExtension, ExtensionError and the sendMessage/sendUserMessage actions. tool_call input is one JSON value, not upstream's per-tool narrowed variants; compaction details are the typed read/modified file lists. context/context_with_system (results carry messages; no in-place edits). input (InputEvent/InputSource/InputEventResult; no images is an empty list) and sendUserMessage's options (deliverAs, expandPromptTemplates). before_agent_start (BeforeAgentStartEvent/Result; the result also carries edited options) and the setModel action. session_start, session_before_switch, session_before_fork (with Ctx.ForkPosition) and session_shutdown with their results. InlineExtension also has bare factories (BareExtension, <inline:N>). ToolDefinition (execute receives the extension context; no renderers, prepareArguments or constrained sampling), RegisteredTool, ToolInfo and the tool actions. user_bash (UserBashEvent; UserBashEventResult as operations or result), flags (FlagOptions with flagType, since `type` is a keyword; ExtensionFlag, FlagValue), shortcuts (ShortcutOptions, ExtensionShortcut) and AppendEntry. Missing: session_info events, model/thinking select, provider request/response, UI prompt events, renderer registration types. ExtensionContext (context.bend) has sessionManager (a ReadonlySessionManager snapshot of the bound session's record, queried with session-manager's pure functions; None before a session binds the runner, as the native runner is created before its session) and ui.theme (the bound UI's live theme; upstream's no-UI context answers the process-global theme, which the native modes do not have, so it is None without a UI or when RPC mode binds no theme). The built-in tools read a narrower ContextView through a reader the runner owns (tool-context.bend), so the context can name the session's tool-details type. ProviderRegistration distinguishes native providers with an optional stream callback from config overlays; deferred ProviderChange/PendingProvider retain the registration value.

packages/coding-agent/src/core/model-run.note: ModelRuntime holds a pi-ai Models collection (AiModels.Models, upstream this.models) with the effective providers: the composition of built-in and models.json providers with native extension providers in place, in upstream providerIds() order; registering or unregistering an extension provider rebuilds the collection (every refresh in flight superseded, the replaced id's catalog dropped) and restores cached catalogs without network access. refresh, checkAuth, getAuth and login delegate to the collection; login then refreshes the provider's availability, and a pre-aborted login answers 'Login cancelled'. The availability snapshot (configured providers and available models, narrowed by filterModels) is computed by refreshAvailability and merged per provider by refreshProviderAvailability as upstream. getAuth(model) adds the configured models.json model headers over the collection's. Reviewed create(): CreateModelRuntimeOptions' modelsStore, modelsStorePath, allowModelNetwork (with PI_OFFLINE), catalogBaseUrl, signal and refreshOnCreate; the store is the injected one, else a FileModelsStore (models-store.json beside models.json), else in-memory without models.json; built-in providers other than Radius are wrapped with withRemoteCatalog; the create-time refresh restores cached catalogs (tests/remote-catalog.bend, tests/radius.bend). The runtime owns the file store's read state (a Serial owner in a Ref, retired in dispose after the store's callbacks), where upstream shares one module-level read state per path. Catalogs published by built-in providers composed with models.json pass through the entry and its modelOverrides (Composer.overlaidRefresh), as upstream's composed getModels (tests/models_json_check.py). Not ported: modelRefreshTimeoutMs, reloading models.json on refresh, models.json overlays on native extension providers, per-provider credential-operation serialization and complete synchronizeCredentialState behavior. Native/config extension registrations retain their optional streams and config fields alongside the collection; every registration or removal rebuilds the collection before availability refresh. ModelRuntime.streamSimple/complete resolves auth, applies header transforms and dispatches an extension stream or the runtime API transport. The custom compaction example checks the native stream path; config registration precedence and lifecycle remain unvalidated.
